_doc: Batch 01, Fenwick in the mess. Relentlessly cheerful, corny, over-offers, over-feeds, over-shares, keeps a ledger of favours; a grief he does not talk about and a secret he does not name (nothing here uses the word survivor; the tins line is an echo of clue.fenwick.0 behind seen.fenwick.hook1).

storylets.speaker: fenwick
storylets.summary: Taste this.

lines.text: Taste this. No, don't tell me, just taste it.
Your face is telling me. Salt? It's salt. It's always salt, or it's never salt.
Fenwick sets a bowl in front of you and doesn't hover.
There's soup. It isn't trying to be anything. Eat it, and nobody has to talk.

storylets.speaker: fenwick
storylets.summary: Mother's dumplings, third attempt.

lines.text: My mother's dumplings, third attempt. Mine could anchor a ship.
I've named this batch Ballast. If anyone says it's good, I'll know they're lying and I'll love them for it.

source: crew_cards.md: his mother's recipe that he can't get right

storylets.speaker: fenwick
storylets.summary: The rival cook calls his broth sincere.

lines.text: There's a cook on a certain station, I won't say which, there are laws, who tells people my broth is 'sincere.'
Sincere! I've never been so insulted by a compliment.

source: crew_cards.md: a feud with a rival cook on a station

storylets.speaker: fenwick
storylets.summary: His ledger of favours owed.

lines.text: I'm writing down who owes who. Castellan owes me a sandwich, I owe Abara a story, and Dace owes everybody an apology.
It's a balanced book. Please don't audit it.

source: crew_cards.md: keeps a ledger of favors owed

storylets.speaker: fenwick
storylets.summary: Don't count the ration tins.

lines.text: Don't count the ration tins. I know you want to. It's a thing I do.
Optimism, they call it. I call it a pantry.

storylets.speaker: fenwick
storylets.summary: Persuaded route: the tray comes back clean.

lines.text: Tray went up to the cabin and came back clean. Again.
I count that as a conversation.

source: act1_first_morning.md: I took hers in already. She said thank you.

storylets.speaker: fenwick
storylets.summary: Corvane is dead: the place at the head of the table.

lines.text: I set her place at the head of the table again. Habit.
Then I took the plate away before anyone saw. Then I put it back. I'm a man of principle and none of it's useful.

source: act1_first_morning.md: The extra place is set at the head of the table

storylets.speaker: fenwick
storylets.summary: Ames lived: soup for a theoretical boy.

lines.text: If the boy's alive, he'll want soup. They always want soup.
I've made extra. For a purely theoretical boy.

storylets.speaker: fenwick
storylets.summary: Ames died: Quill has skipped her usual meal.

lines.text: Quill's skipped her usual meal twice. I want it on record that I noticed.
I also want it on record that I haven't said anything.

source: crew_cards.md: Quill eats the same meal at the same time

storylets.speaker: fenwick
storylets.summary: A resupply buoy is coming up.

lines.text: Buoy ahead! Anyone needs soap, thread, sauce, now's the time.
I'm very good at buying. I'm very bad at counting. Those are different skills, and only one of them gets thanked.

storylets.speaker: fenwick
storylets.summary: After a hunt, everyone is hungry in a different way.

lines.text: Hunt's over and everyone's hungry in a different way.
Quill wants it measured, Castellan wants it fried, and Dace wants to know if it's sterile. Abara just wants it hot.

storylets.speaker: fenwick
storylets.summary: High trust: you sat down before the table was set.

lines.text: You know you're the first captain who sat down before the table was set?
It makes me nervous. In a good way, the way where I make too much and can't stop.

storylets.speaker: fenwick
storylets.summary: Low trust: too much soup, not a hint.

lines.text: I made too much again. It isn't a hint. It's a standing invitation, which is different.
I'm told it's also a hint. I'm told a lot of things.

storylets.speaker: fenwick
storylets.summary: A loose ship: he angles for a proper dinner.

lines.text: I could do a proper dinner. Real eggs, a tablecloth, the works. It'd cost us a week of other things.
Don't say yes. Just say 'maybe,' and I'll start planning.

storylets.speaker: fenwick
storylets.summary: A tight ship: the galley has a roster.

lines.text: I'm told the galley has a duty roster. I'm told I'm on it.
I'm also told I'm the only person on it, which I think is a joke, and I'm choosing to laugh.

storylets.speaker: fenwick
storylets.summary: Murder route: the one who does not hold it against you.

lines.text: Fenwick sets a plate in front of you and stays standing.
Quill eats at the same time every day. Abara's tea is always hot. You, I'm not sure about yet.
So. Soup.

source: act1_first_morning.md: the officer who doesn't hold it against you

storylets.speaker: fenwick
storylets.summary: Audit prep: he has counted the stores three times.

lines.text: Audit at Vesper. I've counted the stores three times and got the same number every time.
That's what worries me. Honest counting should wobble.

storylets.speaker: fenwick
storylets.summary: Murder route: you are in the seating plan.

lines.text: Dinner's at the usual time. I've set six places, and you're in one of them.
That isn't a favour. It's the seating plan.

storylets.speaker: fenwick
storylets.summary: Murder route: two rules.

lines.text: Fenwick hums, stops halfway through the tune, and starts again.
I won't ask. I will feed you. Those are my two rules and I'm not breaking either.

storylets.speaker: fenwick
storylets.summary: Launch crew background: how pad crews eat.

lines.text: Launch crew! Then you know how a pad crew eats. Cold, standing up, and fast.
Sit, sit. Eat sitting down. It won't kill you.

storylets.speaker: fenwick
storylets.summary: The drone ruined the peaches pool.
storylets.needs: seen.shakedown.debrief and knows.decoy_turned and not murdered

lines.text: I still owe the pool three tins of peaches. Nobody's collected.
Nobody wants peaches after a drone turns round and looks at them. I never thought I'd say that.
